title: Support triage
subtitle: Turn customer messages into reviewed next steps
empty: No tickets yet. Create the first one to get started.
subject: Subject
note: Review and edit the suggestion before saving. This app does not send replies.
error.invalid_input: Enter a subject (3–160 characters) and a customer message (10–12,000 characters). Keep the supporting quote in the original text.
error.conflict: This ticket changed elsewhere. Refresh to load the saved version; your edits are still here.
error.invalid_state: This action is no longer available. Refresh the ticket.
error.model_unavailable: The model is unavailable. Check the model configuration and retry this ticket.
error.model_timeout: The model timed out. Your message is saved. Retry when the model is ready.
error.invalid_model_output: The model returned an invalid suggestion or an unsupported quote. Retry this ticket.
error.demo_failure: A model failure was simulated. Your original message is saved; retry with the real model.
error.demo_disabled: Failure simulation is disabled. Enable it in the test plugin configuration.
error.generic: The action could not finish. Your edits are preserved. Refresh or retry.
error.host_timeout: The host did not respond. Refresh to check the saved state before retrying.
